summary: The live planner collects the free FPL slate and refuses to pick a team without a Gemini minutes file. Odds stay on a snapshot. Captain, bench, and the official formations including 5-2-3 are wired. Chips follow the expected-points policy for blanks and doubles. The GW6 slate is a single gameweek, so no chip is played. Published xp_ft was not rerun.
